buildCam: decad.Extrude#1 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, s, profile, decad.Distance{D: units.Millimeters(top - bottom), Dir: decad.Along})
decad.Extrude#2 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, s, profile, decad.Distance{D: units.Millimeters(height), Dir: decad.Along})
buildCamBridge: decad.Extrude#1 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, s, profile, decad.Distance{D: units.Millimeters(2 * half), Dir: decad.Along})
buildCavity: decad.Extrude#1 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, cs, cavityProfile, decad.Distance{D: units.Millimeters(stack + planeGap + 1), Dir: decad.Along})
buildDiscSampled: decad.Extrude#1 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, s, profile, decad.Distance{D: thickness, Dir: decad.Along})
buildHousing: decad.Extrude#1 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, os, outerProfile, decad.Distance{D: units.Millimeters(stack - bottom), Dir: decad.Along})
decad.Extrude#2 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, hs, holeProfile, decad.Distance{D: units.Millimeters(-bottom + 1), Dir: decad.Along})
buildOutput: decad.Extrude#1 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, ps, plateProfile, decad.Distance{D: thickness, Dir: decad.Along})
decad.Extrude#2 decad.Extrude(ctx, r.doc, pins, seed, decad.TwoSided{One: decad.DistanceSide{D: thickness}, Two: decad.DistanceSide{D: height}})
